Independent verification binds evidence to the current assignment. Solana is intended to enforce who can claim, how much and only once.
SETTLEMENT / AUTHORITY ON SOLANA
WHY SOLANA BELONGS HERE

The planned program holds mission escrow, versions task assignments and limits claims to the authorized operator after verifier approval. A stale assignment must not collect. A retry must not pay twice.
Solana enforces financial rules and authorization. It does not establish physical truth; evidence still needs independent verification.

This release establishes the visual language, navigation and entry routes. The port is an original concept illustration. The 3D mission world, telemetry, AI recovery, organization accounts and Solana flows are future integrations.
